messages:
marta: Quick idea: separate tenant routing from RBAC by adding a tiny auth-delegate service. Goal: cut dashboard p95 on high-fanout queries and make auth logic versionable + cacheable.

sam: How do you see the call graph? who owns cache invalidation?

marta: edge -> router -> tenant-tag -> check local cache -> call auth-delegate on miss -> route fanout. Auth team owns delegate; router owns integration + local cache and invalidation hooks.

li: Stale-allow risk: if admin revokes, cached allow could linger.

marta: Mitigations: short default TTL (30s), policy-hash header, and a write-side invalidation event that bumps hash. On mismatch delegate forces authoritative decision.

jena: Tokens: do we want router to exchange tokens?

marta: Propose router mints short-lived router-assertion signed by control-plane (30s). Delegate accepts either orig bearer or assertion. Avoids heavy token introspection in delegate.

li: Latency concern — an external decision per request could add up.

marta: Plan: local fast-path cache (target 95% hit), batch decision per root-request (one call covers fanout), async refresh on miss. SLA target: <1ms p50, <5ms p95 decision overhead.

jena: Auditing: customers need per-decision logs.

marta: auth-delegate emits structured audit events to Kafka. Sampling: 100% for admin changes, ~1% for normal reads. Router forwards trace_id + tenant_id.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI 'auth-delegate-integration' flaky in staging; policy reload blocking requests ~500ms. https://ci.redwood.example/runs/99321 :warning:

sam: Need canary/rollback plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with metric gates. Add circuit-breaker that falls back to legacy inline auth (fail-open=false).

li: Also need attributes back (feature flags/quota_class) so router can pick materialization.

marta: Delegate returns attributes map used by router for routing + tagging.

jena: Dedicated/private customers may want per-customer delegate.

marta: Support two modes: shared multi-tenant delegate or per-customer deploy in Dedicated VPC. Mode selected by customer profile.

sam: Security: nonce + replay protection for router-assertion?

marta: Include nonce + audit_id and short expiry. Delegate verifies signature and nonce.

marta: Small API sketch for RFC:
POST /v1/decide
Headers: x-tenant-id, Authorization: Bearer <router-assertion>, x-policy-hash
Body: {"resource":"dashboard.view","action":"read","context":{}}
Response: {"decision":"allow","cache_ttl":30,"policy_hash":"v2-abc","attributes":{"feature_grants":["new-proj"]}}

jena: Perf tests we need before canary?

marta: Synthetic p95 with fanout N=20, cache-hit vs miss, policy-reload storm, and delegate-delay resilience test (validate circuit-breaker).

ops-bot: staging logs attached to run 99321 1. @marta @sam please triage.

sam: Next: short RFC with API + perf targets + rollout plan + telemetry. Also a migration adapter to switch routes gradually and a feature flag for per-tenant batching.

marta: I'll draft RFC and a mock server for integration tests. Target RFC by EOD Friday. :smile:

li: I'll own token-exchange checklist and invalidation hooks.

jena: I'll get compliance requirements for audit export and retention.

marta: Thanks everyone.
